headline: US Michigan Consumer Sentiment Falls Slightly in Preliminary Reading
summary: The University of Michigan consumer sentiment index declined slightly in October, coming in below analyst forecasts.
why: Consumer confidence indicators gauge willingness to spend, offering predictive value for retail sales and macroeconomic growth.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Weaker consumer sentiment often correlates with a cautious approach to discretionary household spending.

why_moved: Sub-consensus consumer sentiment reports influence macroeconomic expectations regarding consumer spending resilience.
